lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: By the next morning, Devraj's apology had reached every courtyard. So had another fact. Kavita had found the five lakh rupees.
lines.sfx_cue: police station gate clanging shut, crowded voices

lines.speaker: raghav
lines.text: You froze my cousin's cooperative account without one question to me.

lines.speaker: kavita
lines.text: I am asking now. Explain the deposit dated the third of May, twenty twenty-one.

lines.speaker: raghav
lines.text: It was for a tractor.

lines.speaker: meera
lines.text: You said the money was not paid to you. You did not say it was sitting with your cousin.

lines.speaker: raghav
lines.text: Because it was not my account. That distinction is usually understood by adults.

lines.speaker: devraj
lines.text: Speak without insulting my daughter.

lines.speaker: raghav
lines.text: Your family arrangements change very quickly, Devraj.

lines.speaker: devraj
lines.text: My mistake does not make your answer true.

lines.speaker: kavita
lines.text: Good. Everyone has finished performing. Sit down, Raghav.

lines.speaker: raghav
lines.text: I prefer to stand.

lines.speaker: kavita
lines.text: Then stand beside the account statement, where everybody can see both of you.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: The public desk became a hearing without a judge. Villagers filled the doorway. Meera stood where she could see Raghav's face.
lines.sfx_cue: ceiling fan rattling, low crowd murmur

lines.speaker: kavita
lines.text: Cooperative account ending four one nine two. Account holder, Raghav's cousin. Deposit, five lakh rupees. Date, third of May, twenty twenty-one.

lines.speaker: raghav
lines.text: Correct. A commercial deposit is not a crime.

lines.speaker: kavita
lines.text: Who deposited it?

lines.speaker: raghav
lines.text: A tractor buyer.

lines.speaker: kavita
lines.text: Name.

lines.speaker: raghav
lines.text: The papers are old. I cannot remember every farmer who asks for machinery.

lines.speaker: meera
lines.text: But you remembered the date in front of the village. Eighteen months later. Before I told police the amount.

lines.speaker: raghav
lines.text: I remembered because the accusation was repeated to me.

lines.speaker: kavita
lines.text: By whom?

lines.speaker: raghav
lines.text: People talk.

lines.speaker: kavita
lines.text: Name one person.

lines.speaker: raghav
lines.text: This is becoming theatrical.

lines.speaker: meera
lines.text: No. Theatre gives the audience a lie and tells them it is a lie. You asked us to call yours truth.

lines.speaker: raghav
lines.text: I arranged a tractor inquiry. That is why the date stayed in my mind. There. Your mystery is finished.

lines.speaker: kavita
lines.text: You arranged it?

lines.speaker: raghav
lines.text: I connected the buyer to my cousin. I did not receive the money.

lines.speaker: kavita
lines.text: So when you said you knew nothing about the payment, that was false.

lines.speaker: raghav
lines.text: No. You are flattening a commercial transaction into a confession.

lines.speaker: devraj
lines.text: You knew the date because you arranged the deposit.

lines.speaker: raghav
lines.text: I knew a tractor booking date. Meera later attached her story to it.

lines.speaker: meera
lines.text: My story? You watched Shahid count the notes twice. Bundles of five hundred. You took one bundle back because it was short.

lines.speaker: raghav
lines.text: That is an allegation from a woman whose rental signature has already been called false.

lines.speaker: kavita
lines.text: Copied. The examiner called it copied, not false. Do not improve the evidence while quoting it.

lines.speaker: raghav
lines.text: Then arrest the handwriting.

lines.speaker: kavita
lines.text: The account statement includes a deposit slip reference. Your cousin signed the slip. The depositor field contains initials.

lines.speaker: raghav
lines.text: Initials are not a person.

lines.speaker: kavita
lines.text: They match the initials used by Shahid on two transport receipts.

lines.speaker: raghav
lines.text: Many people share initials.

lines.speaker: meera
lines.text: Then bring Shahid here.

lines.speaker: raghav
lines.text: You seem very eager to see the man you claim imprisoned you.

lines.speaker: meera
lines.text: I am eager for him to see that I came back.

lines.speaker: devraj
lines.text: And that she did not come back alone.

lines.speaker: raghav
lines.text: Please. A father's courage, after signing his daughter dead, is not evidence.

lines.speaker: kavita
lines.text: Quiet. Raghav, threats disguised as insults remain threats when twenty people hear them.

lines.speaker: raghav
lines.text: I threatened nobody. I am concerned Devraj may damage his health by becoming emotional.

lines.speaker: devraj
lines.text: My health is not in your account.

lines.speaker: kavita
lines.text: The tractor. Manufacturer?

lines.speaker: raghav
lines.text: A standard farm model.

lines.speaker: kavita
lines.text: Manufacturer?

lines.speaker: raghav
lines.text: I don't... I did not handle delivery.

lines.speaker: kavita
lines.text: Model number?

lines.speaker: raghav
lines.text: Ask my cousin.

lines.speaker: kavita
lines.text: We did. He said you chose the vehicle and brought the buyer.

lines.speaker: raghav
lines.text: Then he is mistaken.

lines.speaker: meera
lines.text: Your cousin remembers you. You remember the date. Neither of you remembers the buyer.

lines.speaker: kavita
lines.text: Or the tractor.

lines.speaker: raghav
lines.text: A booking can be cancelled.

lines.speaker: kavita
lines.text: Then there should be a refund.

lines.speaker: raghav
lines.text: Perhaps there was.

lines.speaker: kavita
lines.text: There was not.

lines.speaker: raghav
lines.text: Then the amount may have been adjusted against another vehicle.

lines.speaker: kavita
lines.text: Which vehicle?

lines.speaker: raghav
lines.text: You have the account. You tell me.

lines.speaker: kavita
lines.text: I have every debit for the next six months. No tractor dealer received money from this account.

lines.speaker: raghav
lines.text: Cash settlement.

lines.speaker: kavita
lines.text: Five lakh rupees in cash, with no receipt?

lines.speaker: raghav
lines.text: Village commerce does not always ask police permission.

lines.speaker: meera
lines.text: Neither did you, when you took me to Kota.

lines.speaker: raghav
lines.text: You went willingly.

lines.speaker: meera
lines.text: Then why did you remove my phone battery?

lines.speaker: raghav
lines.text: I did not.

lines.speaker: meera
lines.text: Why did you tell Tara I had chosen another life?

lines.speaker: raghav
lines.text: I did not speak to Tara.

lines.speaker: devraj
lines.text: You spoke to me. You said searching would shame the children.

lines.speaker: raghav
lines.text: I offered practical advice to a distressed family.

lines.speaker: meera
lines.text: You offered us silence. My father accepted it. I will not.

lines.speaker: kavita
lines.text: Raghav, was the deposit connected to Meera?

lines.speaker: raghav
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: kavita
lines.text: Was it connected to Shahid?

lines.speaker: raghav
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: kavita
lines.text: Was there a tractor?

lines.speaker: raghav
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: kavita
lines.text: Then give me its chassis number by five this evening.

lines.speaker: raghav
lines.text: That deadline is unreasonable.

lines.speaker: kavita
lines.text: You have remembered the transaction for eighteen months. Five hours is generous.

lines.speaker: raghav
lines.text: And if an old office cannot find one number?

lines.speaker: kavita
lines.text: Then I ask the district transport office whether your tractor ever existed.

lines.speaker: raghav
lines.text: You are treating clerical delay as criminal intent.

lines.speaker: kavita
lines.text: I am treating five lakh rupees as five lakh rupees.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: At five, Raghav returned with no chassis number, no invoice and no buyer. Kavita returned with a certified search.
lines.sfx_cue: rubber stamp striking paper, evening crowd murmuring

lines.speaker: raghav
lines.text: A registration search proves nothing. Farm vehicles remain unregistered for months.

lines.speaker: kavita
lines.text: Not this dealer's vehicles. The dealer says no order was placed by you, your cousin or this account holder.

lines.speaker: raghav
lines.text: Dealers lose records.

lines.speaker: kavita
lines.text: Banks do not lose the date stamped on a deposit.

lines.speaker: meera
lines.text: Say the dates together.

lines.speaker: kavita
lines.text: The money entered your cousin's account on the third of May, twenty twenty-one.

lines.speaker: meera
lines.text: And I disappeared?

lines.speaker: kavita
lines.text: On the fifth of May, twenty twenty-one.

lines.speaker: raghav
lines.text: Coincidence is not evidence.

lines.speaker: kavita
lines.text: No. The account is evidence. The dates are evidence. Your changing answers are evidence.

lines.speaker: devraj
lines.text: And the tractor?

lines.speaker: kavita
lines.text: The account received the five lakh rupees two days before Meera disappeared.

lines.speaker: kavita
lines.text: But the tractor was never registered.

lines.speaker: tara
lines.text: Do not let her follow us. If she is really my mother, she will know where to go.
lines.sfx_cue: garden hoe biting dry earth, children whispering

lines.speaker: mohan
lines.text: She is Ma. You heard the lullaby.

lines.speaker: tara
lines.text: You wanted her to be Ma before she opened her mouth.

lines.speaker: mohan
lines.text: And you wanted her to be a stranger.

lines.speaker: tara
lines.text: I wanted nobody to leave twice.
lines.sfx_cue: small clay object scraping against metal

lines.speaker: mohan
lines.text: There. The bird still has one wing.

lines.speaker: tara
lines.text: Put it back. Deep. Then cover the soil properly.

lines.speaker: mohan
lines.text: What if she does not remember?

lines.speaker: tara
lines.text: Then I stop making excuses for her.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Tara buried the clay bird again before breakfast. By noon, she had gathered half the village beneath the neem tree.
lines.sfx_cue: village courtyard crowd, neem leaves rustling

lines.speaker: meera
lines.text: Why are all these people here?

lines.speaker: tara
lines.text: Because everybody watched when Grandfather called you a stranger. They can watch this too.

lines.speaker: devraj
lines.text: Tara, if this is another public test—

lines.speaker: tara
lines.text: It is my test. You had yours. Police had theirs. Now I decide.

lines.speaker: kavita
lines.text: What are the rules?

lines.speaker: tara
lines.text: Nobody answers for her. Nobody gives hints. Nobody tells me that fingerprints are enough.

lines.speaker: mohan
lines.text: Fingerprints are enough.

lines.speaker: tara
lines.text: Mohan.

lines.speaker: mohan
lines.text: Fine. I will not give hints.

lines.speaker: meera
lines.text: Ask.

lines.speaker: tara
lines.text: Not yet. First, tell everyone what you want from this house.

lines.speaker: meera
lines.text: You and Mohan.

lines.speaker: tara
lines.text: That is not an answer. We are not objects kept in a cupboard.

lines.speaker: meera
lines.text: I want to live where my children do. I want to cook badly in my own kitchen. I want to know which schoolbook Mohan has lost this week.

lines.speaker: mohan
lines.text: Geography.

lines.speaker: tara
lines.text: No hints.

lines.speaker: meera
lines.text: And I want Tara to stop standing near every doorway, ready to run if I say the wrong thing.

lines.speaker: tara
lines.text: I do not do that.

lines.speaker: meera
lines.text: You are doing it now.

lines.speaker: tara
lines.text: Maybe I like the doorway.

lines.speaker: meera
lines.text: You hated doorways. You said they made every room look unfinished.

lines.speaker: tara
lines.text: That could be in a diary.

lines.speaker: meera
lines.text: You never kept a diary. You wrote one page, then tore it because Mohan drew a buffalo over your secret.

lines.speaker: mohan
lines.text: It looked better.

lines.speaker: tara
lines.text: This is not the test.

lines.speaker: kavita
lines.text: Then begin it.

lines.speaker: tara
lines.text: Before you disappeared, I made something. I hid it. Nobody from police found it. It is not in any statement.

lines.speaker: devraj
lines.text: What did you make?

lines.speaker: tara
lines.text: I said nobody answers for her.

lines.speaker: devraj
lines.text: I was only— yes. Ask her.

lines.speaker: tara
lines.text: What was it?

lines.speaker: meera
lines.text: You made many things. A clay cup that leaked. A horse with five legs.

lines.speaker: tara
lines.text: So you do not know.

lines.speaker: meera
lines.text: I did not finish.

lines.speaker: tara
lines.text: Then finish.

lines.speaker: meera
lines.text: A bird.

lines.speaker: mohan
lines.text: She knows.

lines.speaker: tara
lines.text: What colour?

lines.speaker: meera
lines.text: None. You refused paint because you said real sparrows did not wear festival colours.

lines.speaker: tara
lines.text: How many wings?

lines.speaker: meera
lines.text: Two when you made it. One after you dropped it beside the stove.

lines.speaker: tara
lines.text: Where did I hide it?

lines.speaker: meera
lines.text: You told me you threw it away.

lines.speaker: tara
lines.text: Then you do not know where it is.

lines.speaker: meera
lines.text: I know you were lying.

lines.speaker: tara
lines.text: That is not a place.

lines.speaker: meera
lines.text: You had soil beneath your fingernails. Red soil, not the grey dust near the wall.

lines.speaker: tara
lines.text: There is red soil in three parts of the courtyard.

lines.speaker: meera
lines.text: You came inside with neem leaves caught in your braid.

lines.speaker: tara
lines.text: There are neem leaves everywhere.

lines.speaker: meera
lines.text: Not in the kitchen. Not behind the water drum. Under this tree.

lines.speaker: tara
lines.text: Where under the tree?

lines.speaker: meera
lines.text: Near the root shaped like a bent knee.

lines.speaker: tara
lines.text: There are four roots.

lines.speaker: meera
lines.text: The eastern root. Three handspans from the trunk.

lines.speaker: tara
lines.text: Why there?

lines.speaker: meera
lines.text: Because that was where I buried your first tooth after you asked whether a new one could grow from the ground.

lines.speaker: tara
lines.text: Nobody knew about the tooth.

lines.speaker: meera
lines.text: You and I knew.

lines.speaker: tara
lines.text: I never told Mohan.

lines.speaker: mohan
lines.text: You told me this morning.

lines.speaker: tara
lines.text: About the bird. Not the tooth.

lines.speaker: kavita
lines.text: Has the location ever appeared in a police statement, school record or family testimony?

lines.speaker: tara
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: kavita
lines.text: Did anyone tell Meera before this test?

lines.speaker: tara
lines.text: No. I buried it again myself.

lines.speaker: meera
lines.text: Again?

lines.speaker: tara
lines.text: I checked that it was still there.

lines.speaker: meera
lines.text: You dug it up without me.

lines.speaker: tara
lines.text: You were dead.

lines.speaker: meera
lines.text: I know what the register said.

lines.speaker: tara
lines.text: No. You don't... you do not know what that did here. Every person brought food. Every person spoke softly. Then they went home.

lines.speaker: meera
lines.text: And you stayed.

lines.speaker: tara
lines.text: I stayed with a brother who woke up calling for you. I stayed with Grandfather, who said questions were disrespectful.

lines.speaker: devraj
lines.text: Tara, I was ashamed and afraid.

lines.speaker: tara
lines.text: I am not asking you.

lines.speaker: meera
lines.text: You stayed. I was not here. Both are true.

lines.speaker: tara
lines.text: If I accept you, what happens when police call tomorrow? What happens when Kota calls? What happens when Raghav walks free?

lines.speaker: meera
lines.text: I answer the police. I go to Kota if the inquiry needs me. And every time, I tell you before I leave.

lines.speaker: tara
lines.text: People promise that when they want entry.

lines.speaker: meera
lines.text: Then do not give me trust today. Give me one night.

lines.speaker: tara
lines.text: One night?

lines.speaker: meera
lines.text: Let me sleep in my house. If you wake, I will be there. If Mohan calls, I will answer. Tomorrow, you decide again.

lines.speaker: mohan
lines.text: She can sleep beside us.

lines.speaker: devraj
lines.text: The house is hers too.

lines.speaker: tara
lines.text: You do not decide that.

lines.speaker: devraj
lines.text: No. I don't. I have decided enough for all of you.

lines.speaker: kavita
lines.text: There is no police restriction preventing Meera from staying with her children. The identity certificate remains disputed, not cancelled.

lines.speaker: tara
lines.text: So the choice is mine?

lines.speaker: kavita
lines.text: The personal choice is yours. The evidence has already made its own.

lines.speaker: VOICE IN CROWD
lines.text: The girl has tested her enough. Let the mother enter.

lines.speaker: SECOND VOICE IN CROWD
lines.text: We all watched her refuse the woman. We should hear her answer now.

lines.speaker: tara
lines.text: Nobody speaks for me.

lines.speaker: meera
lines.text: They did that to you after I disappeared, didn't they?

lines.speaker: tara
lines.text: Every day.

lines.speaker: meera
lines.text: Then take your time.

lines.speaker: tara
lines.text: Dig where you said.

lines.speaker: meera
lines.text: You want me to dig it up?

lines.speaker: tara
lines.text: Three handspans. Eastern root.

lines.speaker: mohan
lines.text: I will help.

lines.speaker: tara
lines.text: No. She knows the place.

lines.speaker: meera
lines.text: The earth is loose here.

lines.speaker: tara
lines.text: Because I buried it again this morning.

lines.speaker: meera
lines.text: I feel something.
lines.sfx_cue: clay clicking against a metal bangle

lines.speaker: mohan
lines.text: Take it out, Ma.

lines.speaker: meera
lines.text: Your bird. One wing. And the beak is still too large.

lines.speaker: tara
lines.text: You said it looked like a crow.

lines.speaker: meera
lines.text: You did not speak to me for two hours.

lines.speaker: tara
lines.text: Three hours.

lines.speaker: meera
lines.text: Then I owe you one hour.

lines.speaker: tara
lines.text: You owe me more than that.

lines.speaker: meera
lines.text: I know.

lines.speaker: tara
lines.text: Tonight, you sleep in the room with us. Not near the door. Mohan kicks when he dreams.

lines.speaker: mohan
lines.text: Only sometimes.

lines.speaker: tara
lines.text: And if police call, you wake me before you go.

lines.speaker: meera
lines.text: I will.

lines.speaker: tara
lines.text: Say it properly.

lines.speaker: meera
lines.text: I will not leave this house without telling you.

lines.speaker: tara
lines.text: Everyone heard that?

lines.speaker: VOICE IN CROWD
lines.text: Everyone heard.

lines.speaker: tara
lines.text: Good.

lines.speaker: meera
lines.text: Tara... may I touch you?

lines.speaker: tara
lines.text: You do not need to ask me that, Mother.

lines.speaker: raghav
lines.text: Remove Kota from my statement. Today. Before the court receives another copy.
lines.sfx_cue: records office door banging open, ledger pages fluttering

lines.speaker: babulal
lines.text: You cannot withdraw a place as if it is a spelling mistake.

lines.speaker: raghav
lines.text: I can correct a statement taken under public pressure.

lines.speaker: babulal
lines.text: You signed every page.

lines.speaker: raghav
lines.text: Then give me a fresh page.

lines.speaker: babulal
lines.text: This is a records office, not a washing stone.

lines.speaker: raghav
lines.text: Your shop is on estate land, isn't it? Paperwork can become tiring when boundaries are reviewed.

lines.speaker: babulal
lines.text: My shop has nothing to do with this file.

lines.speaker: raghav
lines.text: Of course not. I was expressing concern for your workload.

lines.speaker: kavita
lines.text: Express it from the other side of the counter.

lines.speaker: raghav
lines.text: Sub-inspector. Excellent. Tell your clerk that citizens may amend inaccurate statements.

lines.speaker: kavita
lines.text: He is not my clerk. And an amendment does not erase the first statement.

lines.speaker: raghav
lines.text: Then attach my correction. Meera was never in Kota with me.

lines.speaker: meera
lines.text: You stood before the committee and said I travelled there willingly.

lines.speaker: raghav
lines.text: I repeated what I had heard. The crowd was shouting. Questions overlapped.

lines.speaker: kavita
lines.text: Nobody asked whether you had been to Kota. You volunteered details about a transport fee and the payment date.

lines.speaker: raghav
lines.text: I was confused by the accusation.

lines.speaker: meera
lines.text: You were clear enough to call me a woman who abandoned her children.

lines.speaker: raghav
lines.text: I withdraw that too.

lines.speaker: meera
lines.text: You cannot return eighteen months with one sentence.

lines.speaker: raghav
lines.text: I am correcting an error. You should be pleased.

lines.speaker: meera
lines.text: I will be pleased when you say where you left me.

lines.speaker: raghav
lines.text: I left you nowhere, because I did not take you anywhere.

lines.speaker: kavita
lines.text: Your correction will be recorded as a changed account. State the complete version.

lines.speaker: raghav
lines.text: I met Meera near Dharmapur. I did not transport her to Kota. I did not introduce her to Shahid.

lines.speaker: kavita
lines.text: How do you know Shahid's name?

lines.speaker: raghav
lines.text: It has been shouted through the village for days.

lines.speaker: meera
lines.text: Not in front of you.

lines.speaker: raghav
lines.text: Villages have ears even when police pretend they do not.

lines.speaker: kavita
lines.text: Continue.

lines.speaker: raghav
lines.text: I know nothing about a room in Kota. I know nothing about confinement. The five lakh rupees were a tractor deposit unrelated to Meera.

lines.speaker: babulal
lines.text: You did not bring the tractor record.

lines.speaker: raghav
lines.text: The transport search was incomplete.

lines.speaker: kavita
lines.text: It covered every district registration for twelve months after the deposit.

lines.speaker: raghav
lines.text: Then perhaps the buyer changed his mind.

lines.speaker: meera
lines.text: Yesterday, the tractor existed. Today, the buyer changed his mind. Tomorrow, will the account disappear?

lines.speaker: raghav
lines.text: Your confidence is impressive for somebody asking the state to restore her name.

lines.speaker: meera
lines.text: The state marked me dead. I learned not to borrow confidence from paper.

lines.speaker: babulal
lines.text: Paper also marked the certificate disputed.

lines.speaker: raghav
lines.text: After you interfered with it.

lines.speaker: babulal
lines.text: After police ordered a correction.

lines.speaker: raghav
lines.text: You are very brave behind that counter.

lines.speaker: babulal
lines.text: I am... I am careful behind it. That is different.

lines.speaker: kavita
lines.text: And today he will remain careful while you sign your changed statement.

lines.speaker: raghav
lines.text: Gladly.

lines.speaker: kavita
lines.text: Read the last line aloud.

lines.speaker: raghav
lines.text: I state that Meera was never in Kota with me, and any earlier statement suggesting otherwise was made under confusion.

lines.speaker: kavita
lines.text: Date and time.

lines.speaker: raghav
lines.text: The twenty-fourth of November, twenty twenty-two. Ten forty in the morning.

lines.speaker: kavita
lines.text: Sign.
lines.sfx_cue: pen scratching, rubber stamp striking paper

lines.speaker: raghav
lines.text: Finished.

lines.speaker: babulal
lines.text: No. Now I attach it to your first statement.

lines.speaker: raghav
lines.text: Do that. The latest statement controls.

lines.speaker: kavita
lines.text: The court decides what controls.

lines.speaker: raghav
lines.text: Then I have nothing further to say.

lines.speaker: babulal
lines.text: Wait.

lines.speaker: raghav
lines.text: For what?

lines.speaker: babulal
lines.text: You said you were never in Kota with Meera.

lines.speaker: raghav
lines.text: That is what you just stamped.

lines.speaker: babulal
lines.text: Your vehicle number. Does it remain D H seven, C, eight two six four?

lines.speaker: raghav
lines.text: Why?

lines.speaker: babulal
lines.text: Yes or no.

lines.speaker: raghav
lines.text: That vehicle was sold.

lines.speaker: kavita
lines.text: After the dates under inquiry. Was that its number in May twenty twenty-one?

lines.speaker: raghav
lines.text: Yes. Hundreds of people knew it.

lines.speaker: babulal
lines.text: I saw the number this morning.

lines.speaker: raghav
lines.text: In which file?

lines.speaker: babulal
lines.text: Not a police file. An old travel register sent from Kota after a transport office audit.

lines.speaker: raghav
lines.text: Travel registers contain copying errors.

lines.speaker: babulal
lines.text: You have not seen this one.

lines.speaker: raghav
lines.text: I know how roadside clerks write.

lines.speaker: kavita
lines.text: Bring the register.

lines.speaker: babulal
lines.text: It is in the lower records room.

lines.speaker: raghav
lines.text: Before you produce some mouldy book, remember that a vehicle number does not identify its driver.

lines.speaker: meera
lines.text: You recognised the number before he opened the book.

lines.speaker: raghav
lines.text: He spoke my old vehicle number aloud.

lines.speaker: meera
lines.text: And you became frightened.

lines.speaker: raghav
lines.text: Do not mistake irritation for fear.

lines.speaker: kavita
lines.text: Stay here.

lines.speaker: raghav
lines.text: Am I detained?

lines.speaker: kavita
lines.text: No. You may leave. Your statement and vehicle number will remain.

lines.speaker: raghav
lines.text: A courteous threat is still a threat.

lines.speaker: kavita
lines.text: Then you recognised the courtesy.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Babulal returned carrying a register so large he held it against his chest with both arms.
lines.sfx_cue: heavy footsteps, thick ledger thudding onto counter

lines.speaker: babulal
lines.text: Kota commercial travel register. Entry gate, east depot. The binding was never closed after the final page.

lines.speaker: kavita
lines.text: Why was it sent to Dharmapur?

lines.speaker: babulal
lines.text: Vehicle numbers were being compared with local permits. The packet arrived seven months ago. Nobody indexed it.

lines.speaker: raghav
lines.text: So it sat unattended for seven months. Excellent chain of custody.

lines.speaker: kavita
lines.text: It is an administrative register, not seized evidence. We will verify it with the Kota office.

lines.speaker: babulal
lines.text: The page carries their seal and the attendant's initials.

lines.speaker: kavita
lines.text: Find the vehicle.

lines.speaker: babulal
lines.text: There are two entries. Arrival on the fifth of May, twenty twenty-one, at nine twenty in the evening.

lines.speaker: meera
lines.text: The day I disappeared.

lines.speaker: raghav
lines.text: She knows the date. Anyone could have written the number later.

lines.speaker: kavita
lines.text: The ink crosses the page ruling. It was written before the next entry. What name is beside it?

lines.speaker: babulal
lines.text: No driver's name. Only vehicle number, arrival time and passenger count.

lines.speaker: kavita
lines.text: Passenger count?

lines.speaker: babulal
lines.text: Three.

lines.speaker: raghav
lines.text: A commercial vehicle carries passengers. Astonishing.

lines.speaker: meera
lines.text: Raghav drove. I sat in the back. Another man sat beside him.

lines.speaker: kavita
lines.text: That is Meera's assertion. The register independently records three occupants.

lines.speaker: raghav
lines.text: It records a number somebody copied from a passing vehicle.

lines.speaker: babulal
lines.text: The entry is open.

lines.speaker: kavita
lines.text: Meaning?

lines.speaker: babulal
lines.text: Arrival was recorded, but there is no departure on the same line. That is why I noticed it.

lines.speaker: raghav
lines.text: Then it proves the vehicle never left.

lines.speaker: babulal
lines.text: No. The departure was entered four pages later, after the attendant changed shifts.

lines.speaker: kavita
lines.text: Read it.

lines.speaker: babulal
lines.text: Vehicle D H seven, C, eight two six four. Departure, two fourteen in the morning. Passenger count, two.

lines.speaker: meera
lines.text: It arrived with three and left with two.

lines.speaker: raghav
lines.text: Passenger counts are guesses.

lines.speaker: kavita
lines.text: Why is the departure line marked in red?

lines.speaker: babulal
lines.text: The vehicle was linked to an unclosed inquiry. A woman reported missing from the same depot corridor.

lines.speaker: raghav
lines.text: Which woman?

lines.speaker: kavita
lines.text: You said this register was a copying error. Why do you need her name?

lines.speaker: raghav
lines.text: Because you are building another performance around a red line.

lines.speaker: babulal
lines.text: There is a complaint reference in the margin.

lines.speaker: kavita
lines.text: Whom did the complaint concern?

lines.speaker: babulal
lines.text: A second woman connected in the complaint to an alleged buyer. She was last seen near the east depot.

lines.speaker: meera
lines.text: The same place Raghav said he never took me.

lines.speaker: raghav
lines.text: This proves no person was inside my vehicle.

lines.speaker: kavita
lines.text: No. It proves your vehicle entered and departed Kota while you now deny being there.

lines.speaker: raghav
lines.text: On different dates, perhaps.

lines.speaker: babulal
lines.text: The date is written on both pages.

lines.speaker: kavita
lines.text: Read the departure date.

lines.speaker: babulal
lines.text: The sixth of May, twenty twenty-one.

lines.speaker: meera
lines.text: And the missing woman?

lines.speaker: babulal
lines.text: Her complaint gives the same night.

lines.speaker: kavita
lines.text: The register shows Raghav's vehicle left Kota that night.

lines.speaker: kavita
lines.text: The same night the second alleged buyer disappeared.

beat_sheet.what_happened: Kavita confronted Raghav with a five-lakh-rupee deposit made to his cousin's cooperative account on 2021-05-03.

state_changes.fact: The alleged payment was traced to an account connected to his cousin.
Her allegation gained support from a dated financial record.

beat_sheet.what_happened: The certified registration search returned no tractor corresponding to Raghav's stated transaction.

state_changes.fact: No matching tractor registration existed in the searched period.

beat_sheet.note: The automated search completed before any character opened or received the certified result.

beat_sheet.what_happened: Raghav stated that he knew the payment date because he had arranged a tractor inquiry connecting the alleged buyer to his cousin.

state_changes.fact: He publicly acknowledged arranging the transaction whose date he had previously revealed.
Raghav's own explanation established why he knew the exact payment date.

beat_sheet.what_happened: Kavita established that the account received five lakh rupees two days before Meera disappeared and that no tractor was registered for the claimed transaction.

state_changes.fact: The deposit occurred on 2021-05-03, two days before Meera's disappearance on 2021-05-05.
His tractor explanation lacked a corresponding registered vehicle.

beat_sheet.what_happened: Tara secretly reburied her broken clay bird beneath the neem tree and prepared a private-memory test for Meera.

state_changes.fact: She created an identity test based on a detail never entered in official records.

beat_sheet.what_happened: Meera identified the buried object as Tara's one-winged clay bird and located it beside the eastern neem root using a shared memory about Tara's first tooth.

state_changes.fact: Her private memory test supported Meera's identity independently of official records.
She recovered a family memory known only to her and Tara.

beat_sheet.what_happened: Tara allowed Meera to sleep in the family house with both children after Meera promised to tell Tara before leaving for any inquiry.

state_changes.fact: She regained permission to sleep in her own house with Tara and Mohan.
She accepted a direct promise from Meera instead of relying on official evidence.

beat_sheet.what_happened: Tara embraced Meera in front of the village and called her Mother.

state_changes.fact: She publicly accepted Meera as her mother.
The last public refusal within her immediate family ended.

beat_sheet.what_happened: Raghav filed a changed statement denying that he had taken Meera to Kota or introduced her to Shahid.

state_changes.fact: He formally contradicted his earlier public account of Meera's travel to Kota.
Raghav withdrew his allegation that she willingly abandoned her children.

beat_sheet.what_happened: Babulal produced an unclosed Kota travel register bearing Raghav's former vehicle number and an arrival entry dated 2021-05-05 with three occupants.

state_changes.fact: Raghav's vehicle was recorded entering Kota on the day Meera disappeared.
The register contradicted his new denial of a Kota connection.

beat_sheet.what_happened: The travel register recorded Raghav's vehicle leaving Kota at 02:14 on 2021-05-06 with two occupants rather than the three recorded on arrival.

state_changes.fact: The vehicle's passenger count fell from three to two between arrival and departure.
His former vehicle was documented leaving Kota after midnight.

beat_sheet.what_happened: Kavita established that Raghav's vehicle left Kota on the same night a second person connected in a complaint to an alleged buyer disappeared.

state_changes.fact: His vehicle was linked by date and location to a second disappearance involving an alleged buyer.
The complaint date matched the vehicle's overnight departure from Kota.

promise_ledger.listener_is_waiting_for: Whose body was cremated after being wrongly identified as Meera?
How did Raghav know the exact five-lakh-rupee payment date before Meera disclosed the amount?
promise_ledger.how_paid: Raghav acknowledged in the public account confrontation that he had arranged the transaction connecting the alleged buyer to his cousin, which explained his knowledge of the exact deposit date.

promise_ledger.listener_is_waiting_for: Does the matching hospital number prove that the burned woman was Kesar?
Who wrote Meera's name on the unidentified-body form before Devraj signed the identification?
Who was the second person linked to an alleged buyer, and why did Raghav's vehicle leave Kota on the night that person disappeared?

dates_fixed.what: Meera enters Dharmapur police station and discovers that she remains recorded as dead.
Kavita conducts the initial private identity test and finds the tattoo-hand discrepancy.
Meera visits her former house under police guard and the bus stand photograph arrives.
Raghav gives his account before the village committee and reveals knowledge of a payment dated 2021-05-03.
Meera identifies room twelve in Kota, Mohan publicly calls her Ma and the rental ledger reveals a disputed signature dated 2021-06-21.
Kavita conducts the open identity verification and Meera's death certificate is marked disputed.
The four jailed accused appear in court, Salim implicates Raghav and his indexed statement is found missing from the case diary.
The court brings the four accused into the reopened inquiry, and Janki links Kesar's complaint to the burned body's hospital intake number.
Devraj admits that fear and grief caused the mistaken identification and publicly recognises Meera as his daughter.
Kavita traces the five-lakh-rupee deposit dated 2021-05-03 and finds no registered tractor corresponding to Raghav's explanation.
Tara tests Meera with the buried clay bird, publicly accepts her as her mother and allows her to sleep in the family house.
Raghav withdraws his Kota account and Babulal produces the unclosed travel-register entry for Raghav's vehicle.

periods_fixed.elapsed: No time elapsed; both episodes occur on 2022-11-14.
